name: kg_merge_nodes
description: Merge two KG nodes of the same node_type. The `fold_id` node is folded into `keep_id`: every edge pointing at `fold_id` gets rewritten to point at `keep_id`, the fold node's label + aliases are added to keep's aliases, and the fold node is deleted. Atomic. Reversible via the kg_revision_log entry. Refuses to merge across different node_types. Use this for the duplicate / typo-variant case (e.g. 'Aleks' should be merged into 'Alex'). Always pass a non-empty `reason`. Pass `dry_run: true` to see the diff without committing.

inputs.name: keep_id
inputs.description: Surviving node id (gains the alias + edges).

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Why this merge is correct. Goes into kg_revision_log.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.description: Preview the diff; do not commit. Default false.

outputs.description: {ok, revision_log_id, edges_rewritten, new_aliases} on commit; {ok, dry_run, before, after} on dry_run.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for kg_merge_nodes:
- keep_id (required): surviving node id
- fold_id (required): node to fold + delete
- reason (required): why this merge is correct
- dry_run (optional): preview only
- finding_id (optional): source finding row id
